tasks.name: אותה זוגיות?
tasks.note: Parity comparison of two numbers returning a 0/15 flag.

tasks.name: נשא בחיבור
tasks.note: Detects 4-bit overflow of a+b, returning the carry bit 0/1.

tasks.name: שניהם גדולים מ-7?
tasks.note: Logical AND of two threshold tests (both inputs above 7) as a 0/15 flag.

tasks.name: א ועוד חצי ב
tasks.note: Halving one input and adding it to the other modulo 16.

tasks.name: סימן ההפרש
tasks.note: Three-way compare: 1 if a>b, 15 (i.e. -1 mod 16) if a<b, 0 if equal.

tasks.name: מרחק מעגלי
tasks.note: Distance on a 16-hour clock: the shorter of the two ways around.

tasks.name: החצי העליון של המכפלה
tasks.note: High 4 bits of the 8-bit product a*b (floor of a*b/16).

tasks.name: הגבל ליד ב
tasks.note: Clamps a into the window [b-2, b+2] (window edges cut by 0..15 naturally).

tasks.name: מרחק האמינג
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let x=(a^b)&15, c=0; while(x){ c+=x&1; x>>=1; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the bit positions where a and b differ (popcount of a XOR b).

tasks.name: מחלק משותף גדול
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ while(b){ const t=a%b; a=b; b=t; } return a; }
tasks.note: Greatest common divisor by a loop with a decision; gcd(a,0)=a and gcd(0,0)=0.

tasks.name: חזקה מודולו 16
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let r=1; for(let i=0;i<b;i++) r=(r*a)&15; return r; }
tasks.note: a to the power b modulo 16 by repeated multiplication, with a^0=1 (also 0^0=1).

tasks.name: סובב ביטים שמאלה
tasks.note: Rotates the 4 bits of a left by (b mod 4) positions, wrapping the top bits around.
